sources.observation: The west view shows layered gray tile, bright plaster fascia, grouped windows and varied upswept gables.
The lower roofs project beyond white walls, with a bowed central gable below paired triangular forms on the upper stories. The smaller keeps have their own tiers.

limitations: Himeji City’s keep and stone base heights set the main silhouette. Hidden wall details, smaller keep heights, connector elevations and the ridge ornaments use approximate dimensions.
The model scope includes the four joined keeps. Separate defensive gates, towers and bridge connections keep their own map geometry. Terrarium supplies approximate surrounding grades.
